title: Evidence-boundary and negation protection for explicitly curated mathematical formula marks
source: Actual existing practice question bank and marking implementation; this update does not certify full AQA coverage.
finding: Existing expression-alternative shortcut matched formulae as substrings after removing whitespace. Confirmed an incorrect/negated formula could be awarded one mark on two practice question IDs. Additional original AQA regression demonstrated correct superscript scientific notation must still receive full marks.
fixes: Require whole equation evidence rather than a substring inside a longer variable or number
Ignore clearly rejected or negated formulae when deciding whether a method point is earned
Allow spaces around operators and vetted alternative rearrangements such as n=c/v, v=c/n and L=R*A/rho
On short formula-only responses, do not let fuzzy token matching replace the explicitly required formula
Maintain per-point manual marking and detailed review, with no changes to card/question IDs or progress
Treat 2.26×10⁸, 2.26 x 10^8 and 2.26e8 as equivalent forms of the same value, without matching 12.26e8 or 2.26e80.
remaining: Individual answer-level audit of 971 science mock cards lacking direct specRef
Complete AQA requirement-to-answer evidence grid for school mocks and full courses
Broader real student-answer samples and practical/photo diagram marking reliability review
